phases.name: Local-first environment certification and production-safe promotion
phases.objective: Certify Local/Dev on development with dedicated Neon first, then Staging end-to-end, before any Production promotion.
exit_criteria: Local/Dev runs from development with a dedicated Neon database.
The four-plan billing catalog is implemented with stable IDs and 10-day trials.
Dedicated Staging Shopify identity is verified.
Staging Worker, PostgreSQL and Queue/DLQ are healthy.
Staging Shopify auth/session/Admin API reads pass.
The four-plan billing catalog contract is verified in hosted environments.
Production remains unmodified until Staging acceptance evidence exists.

blockers: Real dedicated Neon project vsn-stock-down-sort-local is not provisioned/identified in repository or connected Neon account context. Repository-side enforcement is complete; actual project provisioning and workstation runtime remain external prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: development is the Local integration branch.

Prisma migrations pass on the Local Neon database.
Local credentials do not reuse Staging or Production database identities.

work_units.title: Implement four-plan billing contract
work_units.objective: Replace the single-plan runtime with four stable plan IDs, 10-day trials, capability-aware entitlements and legacy subscription compatibility.
blockers: Real Shopify test-store approval for each plan is still required before billing runtime acceptance is complete.
Public App Pricing migration, if selected, requires Partner Dashboard configuration and Partner API verification.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly starter/growth/pro/unlimited are canonical IDs.
Prices are 10.99/19.99/34.99/54.99 USD every 30 days.
Every plan has a 10-day trial.
Plan changes use Shopify replacement behavior.
Legacy USD 55/5-day subscription remains recognized.
Unimplemented capabilities are not represented as available runtime entitlements.
CI verifies the catalog and billing implementation contracts.
completion_evidence: config/ai/product-plan.json is canonical.
config/ai/options-bank.json contains all referenced options and runtime implementation status.
app/billing-config.ts derives runtime catalog from the canonical files.
app/services/billing.server.ts resolves all four plans and legacy compatibility.
/app/plans exposes all four tiers and prevents unknown active subscription changes.
Subscription API supports plan selection and replacement.
Hosted health/release workflows validate the four-plan catalog.
App Validation #224 passed the previous billing contract before this implementation batch.

work_units.title: Harden isolated PostgreSQL data architecture
work_units.objective: Verify the active cloud PostgreSQL schema and add safe lookup indexing without changing environment boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Active Prisma schema uses PostgreSQL.
Local/Staging/Production database identities remain isolated.
Shopify Session lookup by shop is indexed.
Migration is additive and reversible by standard migration rollback/forward procedure.
completion_evidence: config/database/environment-topology.json enforces Local -> Staging -> Production isolation.
Session.shop index added to prisma/cloud/schema.prisma.
Additive migration 20261001003000_session_shop_index added.
Database architecture contract test added to App Validation.

acceptance_criteria: Environment Secrets Audit passes for staging.

work_units.objective: Verify health, database, queues, sessions, Admin GraphQL and billing reads.

work_units.objective: Release the exact verified staging Shopify configuration only.

work_units.objective: Allow production preparation only after all Staging acceptance evidence is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Staging phase is accepted before production preparation starts.
